mentions.name: BubbleByte
mentions.description: A laid-back open-source incremental game that mixes clicker, idle, automation, and a hint of tower defense, inspired by the author's cat Byte's fascination with soap bubbles. It is built with the author's VRSFML fork and released commercially on Steam.
